description: This file defines a chat grain class 'ChatGrain' implementing event sourcing with Orleans. It manages chat state stored as an XML document, handling chat events like posting, deleting, and editing messages, and ensures proper initialization on activation.

classes.name: ChatGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing event sourcing for a chat application, managing messages and state via XML document, with functionality for initial setup and event handling.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the grain activation method to initialize the chat state if it is new, raising a creation event if needed.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply chat events to the XML document state.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Returns the current chat state as an XML document.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Raises a new chat message event with user input.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Raises an event to delete a message identified by its GUID.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Raises an event to edit an existing message identified by GUID.
